title: tarenna graveolens subsp. arabica
intro: Tarenna graveolens subsp. arabica, commonly known as Arabica Tarenna or Arabica Tarenna leaf, is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the management of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Tarenna graveolens subsp. arabica include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit hepatoprotective effects, and possess anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
